objective_value: <float> Objective value of the primary problem variant solved for this instance: total opening cost of selected facilities for the Partial Set Covering Location Problem, or total covered demand for the Maximal Covering Location Problem.
primary_problem_type: <str> Variant whose value is reported by objective_value; must be one of the instance problem_types.

PSCLP.objective_value: <float> Minimum total opening cost of the selected facilities such that the covered demand meets the required threshold.
PSCLP.open_facilities: <list[int]> Indices of facilities selected to be opened in the Partial Set Covering Location Problem.
PSCLP.covered_demand: <float> Total demand of the customers counted as covered by the selected facilities.

MCLP.objective_value: <float> Maximum total demand of customers counted as covered by the selected facilities while respecting the opening budget.
MCLP.open_facilities: <list[int]> Indices of facilities selected to be opened in the Maximal Covering Location Problem.
MCLP.covered_demand: <float> Total demand of the customers counted as covered by the selected facilities.
